flight_tflite_input.layout_source: TFLite CONV_2D operator convention ([batch,height,width,channels]); the flatbuffer carries no layout metadata

iree_entry_input.layout_source: tflite2onnx re-indexes activations adjacent to Conv/Pool and permutes the 52 Conv filters OHWI->OIHW; no Transpose node is emitted

batch.note: the exporter left the batch symbolic (-1) in shape_signature; the concrete shape the flatbuffer executes with is batch 1 and the IREE entry fixes it to 1. A second narrowing besides layout; P2 compares at batch 1

interface_change_recorded.consequence: P2 must feed the IREE entry NCHW-ordered bytes (a transposed copy of the TFLite NHWC input). The two C executors allocate a contract-shaped buffer view (rank 4 {1,3,224,224}, dense row-major) and fill it in flat index order; the contract carries shape but no NHWC/NCHW semantics, so the caller supplies the order
interface_change_recorded.alternative_not_taken: bake an ONNX Transpose(perm=[0,3,1,2]) at the graph input so the entry keeps the flight NHWC shape -- a new one-invocation build whose contract would change; a P2 design choice, not done in P1

third_source_reconciliation.source: the flight flatbuffer's own constant buffers (tflite schema package), independent of MLIR, dump and vmfb
third_source_reconciliation.delta_explained: 15 tensors of <= 256 B (13 bias vectors, the FC bias [3], the two preprocessing scalars 2.0/1.0) are inlined by iree-compile into the dispatch executables; their bytes appear verbatim in the embedded ELF .rodata (kernel_elf_bytes, outside the HAL boundary the contract counts)
third_source_reconciliation.note: recorded by the adversarial review of E30; the contract's memory_boundary excludes the executable image by definition, so this is a reconciliation, not a discrepancy
third_source_reconciliation.executables_vs_functions: 40 hal.executables (dump/), 39 unique ELF functions (infer_dispatch_35 is folded onto infer_dispatch_23's code by the linker), 56 stream.cmd.dispatch sites

smoke_execution.runner: pip iree.runtime (python bindings), one model per process
smoke_execution.arm_in_this_process: map (peak == per_call exactly; E29's alignment determinant, not controlled here)
smoke_execution.note: feasibility only: the artifact loads and runs; NOT an E26 cell, NOT a soundness or equivalence claim

cfs_interface_fit.note: E28/D52 moved feat[]/out[]/outs[] to static storage sized from the contract, so a 602,112 B input does not live on the task stack

not_claimed: numeric equivalence with the TFLite model (P2)
soundness of bounded/per_call beyond this one pip-runtime process
generalization to other models or compiler versions
byte-reproducibility of the vmfb across iree-compile re-invocations in general (E26e; two calls agreed here, that is all)
